sql_used:
SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS track_count, ROUND(AVG(t.Milliseconds)/60000.0, 2) AS avg_minutes
FROM Track t
JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
ORDER BY m.MediaTypeId;
SELECT MIN(Milliseconds), MAX(Milliseconds), MIN(Milliseconds)/60000.0 AS min_min, MAX(Milliseconds)/60000.0 AS max_min FROM Track;
